title: Canterbury Museum collection record for Moai kavakava, Canterbury — E138.636 /114/38

claims.value: Carved wooden male figure with inlaid eyes of bone and obsidian.
Bequeathed by John Macmillan Brown to: University of Canterbury: Christchurch/Canterbury/South Island/New Zealand: 1935

notes.text: The catalogue number E138.636 and former identifier 114/38 match the IndiGen entry. The museum classifies the figure as “Carving: Moai Tangata”; IndiGen classifies it as Moai kavakava. Museum provenance reports a 1935 bequest from John Macmillan Brown to the University of Canterbury; IndiGen records acquisition in 1938 from the university. The museum provides no measurements on this record. Its image rights are All Rights Reserved, so no image is included.
